note: Guyana, read in the Ministry of Home Affairs' requirements for a landing permit for employment status (moha.gov.gy, a 2021 document current on 2026-10-30). The request is made before arrival (it gives the expected date of arrival and port of entry), with the sponsoring employer's registration, tax and social security receipts, a contract between employer and employee and proof that the post was advertised for three consecutive months (read as work for the sponsor); each application takes one month to process. Its fee and term aren't in the document. The CARICOM skills certificate, permanent residence and the years naturalisation asks weren't found on the Ministry's site and aren't written.

sources.title: Ministry of Home Affairs (Guyana), Requirements for Landing Permit for Employment Status
sources.said: Letter requesting landing Permission for Employment Status ... Expected Date of Arrival ... Copy of sponsor's passport bio-data page or ID Card ... The Vacancy that the applicant will be filling, MUST be advertised in the newspapers for three (3) consecutive months ... Copy of Contract signed between the employer and employee ... Each application takes one (I) month to process.
